burn_scope_read_and_found_none.p4c: acquisition/sources_p4c.py contains no burn, spent or confirmatory-reuse declaration of any kind; its frozen SELECTION_RULE speaks only to cohort construction. Declared burn scope: NONE_DECLARED. Reported exactly and generalised into nothing. Its individual disposition is moot regardless -- one lineage cannot constitute a confirmatory cohort.

cache_identity.historical_p4i_artifacts: UNTOUCHED. Not rewritten, not re-keyed, not migrated.
cache_identity.key: sha256 over the full, untruncated lineage/source identity tuple, plus the revision's raw content digest. No truncation anywhere in the path.
cache_identity.readable_slug_is: a LABEL only, never a key, never compared for identity
cache_identity.still_required: structural collision detection, raw digest verification, canonical digest verification, and whole-collision-group exclusion. A better key reduces collisions; it does not license skipping the check that finds them.

forbidden_in_selection: inspecting revision content in order to choose a candidate
acquiring until a quarantine case appears
removing a pair after seeing its outcome
adding a pair after seeing any outcome
replacing a family after seeing its yield
adjusting a quota, the floor or a threshold after acquisition

integrity_rejection.canonical_digest: recomputed for every revision side; a mismatch rejects the pair
integrity_rejection.collision_groups: collisions are detected STRUCTURALLY. If a cache-key or slug collision makes provenance ambiguous, the ENTIRE collision group is excluded -- never whichever member is convenient. Every exclusion is named and counted.
integrity_rejection.identical_sides: a pair whose two sides carry the same raw digest is rejected as not a revision pair. This is a metadata-level identity check, not a content judgement about whether anything meaningful changed.
integrity_rejection.parse: both sides must parse and yield at least 3 canonical units
integrity_rejection.raw_digest: recomputed for every revision side; a mismatch rejects the pair

quota_basis.basis: grammar breadth and source supply, carried forward from SFI1 through SFI3
quota_basis.explicitly_not_basis: violation rate, pass yield, closure outcome or any V1/V2 observation
quota_basis.floor_prior: FLOOR=200 sized from V1's published 8/514 as a SAMPLE-SIZE PLANNING PRIOR only: 191 pairs reaches about 95.0% and 200 reaches about 95.66% chance of observing at least one old-rate violation. The ratio sizes the experiment and never scores it.
quota_basis.frozen_before: any V2R1 fetch, any V2R1 diff, any V2R1 score
quota_basis.redistribution: forbidden; an under-delivering family is reported short

source_roots.container_level_disjointness: no declared repository appears among the 176 named by any earlier sources module, and no declared CFR part appears among the ~185 already consumed. SEC disjointness is proven per-lineage at enumeration, since its issuer set is a rule rather than a fixed list.
source_roots.probe_asked_only: existence, prefix contents, revision counts and amendment-pair presence -- all metadata. No revision content was read and no identity outcome was inspected.

rule.availability_probe: 20 of the first 25 issuers by CIK carry at least one amendment pair, so the quota is reachable well inside the ordered universe
rule.order: ascending by CIK, which is stable and not chosen by us
rule.pair_construction: a source document is (CIK, base form, period of report). An amendment pair exists where the same (CIK, base form, period) carries both an original filing and its /A amendment. Both sides are named by accession number from the submissions API -- metadata only.
rule.stopping: walk in CIK order until the family quota is met or the universe ends

traversal.attrition: a candidate lost to fetch failure, parse failure or integrity rejection is RECORDED with its reason and never silently replaced. The realised count is whatever survives; the gate is FLOOR.
traversal.container_cap: at most 4 source documents per container -- repository, CFR part, issuer -- so no single container dominates the cohort
traversal.duplicate_rule: deduplicate by lineage id, keeping the first occurrence in traversal order. A lineage reachable from two containers is admitted once.
traversal.order: families in the order FAMILIES declares; within a family, containers sorted lexicographically by container id; within a container, source documents sorted lexicographically by source id. Deterministic, and reproducible from this file without a fetch.
traversal.oversampling: construct up to PRIMARY_TARGET candidates in this order, then filter. Over-selection precedes every outcome. Padding after measurement is forbidden without exception.
traversal.pair_construction: one revision pair per source document: the two most recent DISTINCT revisions by the source's own revision metadata, before-side older. Ties broken by the lexicographically smallest revision identifier. Chosen without reading either revision's content.
traversal.stopping_rule: stop when PRIMARY_TARGET candidates are constructed or the declared sources are exhausted, whichever comes first. NEVER 'keep acquiring until a quarantine case appears' -- a stopping rule that reads the outcome makes selection a function of the result.

permitted_because: no V2R1 acquisition artifact existed and no rung after the protocol had frozen, both checked mechanically rather than asserted

supersedes.why: the superseded frame declared families, quotas and traversal rules but no source repositories, CFR parts or issuer sets. Founder ruling section 7 requires those predeclared; without them the traversal was underdetermined and acquisition could still have reached for convenient material.
